data.text: Now I understand the structure. Let me run a query to get the top products by revenue, joining order_items with products and category_translation, filtering out canceled/unavailable orders, and grouping by English category name.

args.purpose: Top product categories by total revenue from non-canceled/non-unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
    ct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) as order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT order_status FROM orders WHERE orders.order_id = oi.order_id) NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20
